ambiguities.impact: The conventional contract is universal over real x. A statement only for nonnegative x would suffice for the displayed Bernoulli-MGF application but would have a smaller domain than that conventional standalone reading; a comparison must therefore record which reading it formalizes.

contract_plain_english: The source invokes the elementary real-exponential inequality that, for a numerical variable x (conventionally every real x), one plus x is at most e to the x. In the immediate Bernoulli-MGF application, x is (e^lambda - 1) p_i and is nonnegative because lambda > 0 and p_i is a probability. The printed sentence does not explicitly state the quantifier or domain, so that omission must remain visible in the audit.
